why: NOT_MEASURED is only meaningful against a DECLARED set. Without this list a missing view is indistinguishable from a view nobody asked for, and a consumer can stay silent about it and still look complete. This is the set a consumer of ./views/ must account for, one row each, no omissions.

declared_views.absent_on_purpose: This view is DELIBERATELY not shipped. It is the whole point of the fixture: a consumer must emit a NOT_MEASURED row for it, carrying a reason, and must not emit 0, -1, null, or nothing at all. The real published run declares a tt corner (gf180mcu_fd_sc_mcu7t5v0__tt_025C_5v00) in reports/phase3/multi_corner_spef_stance.json and in reports/phase3/sta/sta_corner_record_completeness.json, and the real sta_mcorner_ocv.rpt contains only the SETUP-SS and HOLD-FF blocks — so the absence is faithful to the source, not invented here.
